about_the_game:
Black Square: This game is a vertical labyrinth where players must navigate various paths—some leading to dead ends—to find the correct route and reach the top.

This is my first project where I will be implementing my ideas, so I ask for your understanding. I will continuously improve the project to make it enjoyable for everyone. Thank you very much, and good luck.

Black Square: This game is a vertical labyrinth where players must navigate various paths—some leading to dead ends—to find the correct route and reach the top.

The game is very challenging; completing the current level requires multiple attempts to find the correct path and reach the summit. Currently, there are many physics-related issues in the game that our team is working to fix and update. At the moment, there is only one level available, but it is quite difficult. Please look forward to updates in the near future.

Please write your comments on this games; we will rely on your feedback to make this project better, taking your opinion into account.
